title: TrueRise bounded give-up claim (G44, contracted first version)
description: A give-up claim is bounded or it is nothing: InfeasibleWithinBudget requires a search-surface ledger (tried probes with outcomes, untried ones with their cheapest concrete form and cost), a sealed budget bound, and a retry plan DISJOINT from the tried set. The verdict space is exactly three-valued (completed / not_completed / infeasible_within_budget) and cannot be collapsed. Auto-executed bounded recheck is deferred until G2/G21 budget linkage (consensus v3.3).

contract_sealed_hash.description: the sealed intent contract this claim dispositions (optional outside a contract run)

verdict.description: the give-up verdict; completed/not_completed claims exist in the completion_report surface, not here

verdict_space.description: the complete three-valued space, machine-checked as non-collapsible
